segments.title: Station Sign-On and Pepito Sermon
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the cold-open sign-on as 'Papita', then performs a surreal religious sermon involving a macaroni-and-cheese puddle miracle and a fish-turned-wine blessing.

segments.title: Trump Davos Speech and Greenland Framework
segments.notes: Case covers Trump's Davos address claiming a 'framework for a future deal' on Greenland, threatening 'excessive strength and force' for acquisition; Rick interrupts with 'high T-fax' CIA decoding theory.

segments.title: Sleepy Hype Train Subscriber Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train appears exhausted, delivers a rambling freestyle over Radiohead-type beats covering foot fetishes, sheep, cliffs, and Pokemon Battle Revolution while acknowledging 36–39 month subscribers.

segments.title: Little Nicky Game Boy Color Speedrun Attempt
segments.notes: CryptoZeu$ (Brandon) attempts a speedrun of Little Nicky on Game Boy Color via RetroArch while his mother constantly interrupts from off-camera; stream ends with a raid on Dr. Diggity Dank.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with Pepito's macaroni-themed religious sermon before Case Blackwell covered Trump's Davos speech threatening 'excessive strength and force' to acquire Greenland. A sleep-deprived Hype Train derailed subscriber acknowledgments into a Radiohead-backed freestyle about foot fetishes, while Rick claimed CIA training to decode Trump's 'high-frequency' messaging. The broadcast concluded with CryptoZeu$ attempting a Little Nicky speedrun on Game Boy Color amid relentless off-camera interruptions from his mother, ending in a raid on Dr. Diggity Dank.
